title: Best Siding Colors for Modern Homes
summary: Discover the best siding colors for modern homes in 2027. Explore the latest exterior color trends, from warm neutrals and earth greens to bold statement hues and find inspiration with LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding.
body_markdown:
The shift toward warmer, more natural home design continues, influencing everything from interior finishes to exterior color palettes. Homeowners are in favor of colors that feel timeless, welcoming, and connected to the natural environment.


Whether you’re building a new home, planning a renovation, or looking to boost curb appeal, siding color can impact your home’s appearance and perceived value.


Here are the siding colors that will continue to define homes in 2027.


**Why Exterior Color Matters**


Your siding color influences more than aesthetics. It helps define your home’s character, complements architectural features, and contributes to its overall curb appeal.


The siding color you choose can:


-


Make a home feel modern and updated


-


Highlight architectural details


-


Increase perceived home value


-


Complement roofing, stone, brick, and landscaping


-


Appeal to future buyers


-


Express personal style


Using durable products like LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Trim & Siding combined with the right color can help create a beautiful exterior designed to stand the test of time.


**Warm White**


White remains one of the most popular exterior colors. However, instead of bright, stark whites, homeowners are embracing warmer shades with soft cream, linen, and ivory undertones. These colors create a clean appearance while still feeling inviting.


Warm whites work particularly well on:


-


Modern Farmhouses


-


Coastal Homes


-


Contemporary designs


**Popular color combination:** Warm white siding, black windows, natural wood accents, and a charcoal roof.


**Sage Green**


Sage continues to be a versatile exterior color. Inspired by nature, sage green works across a variety of styles while blending in with landscaping and outdoor surroundings.


The color offers homeowners a sophisticated alternative to traditional gray palettes.


**Popular color combination:** Sage green siding, crisp white trim, and natural stone accents.


**Deep Charcoal Gray**


Dark exteriors remain a favorite for homeowners seeking a sleek, contemporary look. Charcoal delivers depth and sophistication while emphasizing architectural lines and textures. The color provides contrast without overpowering the home’s design


**Popular color combination:** Charcoal gray siding with cedar accents and black-framed windows.


**Earth-Tone Browns**


There is a growing popularity for nature-inspired brown tones. Rich walnut, weathered wood, and earth-toned browns create warmth and authenticity that connect homes to nature.


These colors can be seen in:


-


Mountain homes


-


Modern cabins


-


Contemporary architecture


-


Luxury custom homes


**Popular color combination:** Warm brown siding paired with black trim and natural stone.


**Moody Blue-Greens**


This is an exterior color family that combines elements of blue, green, and gray.


These complex colors feel elevated and custom while maintaining a broad appeal. They provide a distinctive look without overwhelming the home.


**Popular color combination:** Blue-green siding with cedar accents and white trim.


**Soft Black**


Black exteriors will always be a trend. Many homeowners like the softened black shades with subtle gray undertones. These colors create dramatic curb appeal while maintaining sophistication.


When paired with warm wood elements, soft black exteriors feel striking yet approachable.


**Popular color combinations:** Soft black siding and natural wood and stone detailing.


**Natural Wood-Tones**


As homeowners continue to embrace nature-inspired architecture, natural wood aesthetics are becoming a popular trend for exterior design. Warm, organic finishes help create a welcoming appearance while adding texture, depth, and character to modern homes.


For homeowners who love the look of stained wood but want the benefits of engineered wood siding, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding offers curated wood-tone finishes designed to bring warmth and authenticity to exterior designs.


Whether used as a full-home siding solution or as an accent alongside siding, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding can help create the rich, high-end appearance many homeowners seek while complementing today's most popular exterior color palettes.


**Popular Color Combination:** Natural wood-tone siding paired with charcoal accents, black-framed windows, and natural stone details.


**How to Choose the Best Siding Color**


Before committing to an exterior color, consider:


-


Your home’s architecture


-


The best siding color should enhance, not compete with, your home’s design.


-


Long-term appeal


-


Choosing a timeless color often provides long-term value.


-


Existing exterior materials


-


Consider how the siding color will coordinate with roofing, brick, stone, trim, and landscaping

**Frequently Asked Questions**


**What siding colors are expected to trend in 2027?**


In 2027, homeowners are gravitating toward warm whites, earthy greens, and natural wood-toned colors. These colors reflect the growing preference for natural, welcoming designs that connect homes to their surroundings.


**What siding color makes a home look more modern?**


Modern homes often feature clean, sophisticated color palettes such as warm white, charcoal gray, soft black, sage green, and natural-wood tones. These colors pair well with contemporary architectural features and create strong visual contrast with windows, trim, and other exterior materials.


**Should siding match the roof color?**


Siding and roofing don’t need to match exactly, but they should complement one another. Many designers recommend balancing light and dark elements to create visual contrast while maintaining a cohesive exterior color palette.


**Create a timeless Exterior for Years to Come**


The best siding colors combine modern style with lasting curb appeal. Warm neutrals, natural greens, rich earthy tones, and sophisticated dark exteriors are helping homeowners create exteriors that feel both modern and timeless. Selecting the right siding color can dramatically transform your home’s appearance and curb appeal.
